[[File:Anagram reference - Snuggle Bear in a 1985 Snuggle commercial.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Snuggle Bear in a 1985 Snuggle commercial.]]
'''Snuggle Bear''' is the teddy-bear mascot of Snuggle, a fabric softener introduced in 1983 by Unilever and now sold by Henkel in the United States and Canada. The puppet was created by Kermit Love, and the bear was first voiced by Corinne Orr.<ref name="wp-snuggle">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Snuggle Snuggle], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010043104/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Snuggle Internet Archive], 10 October 2026.</ref>

== Star Wars CCG ==
[[File:SE-D-brangusglee.gif|thumb|left|200px|[[Brangus Glee]] ([[Special Edition]])|link=Brangus Glee]]
The [[Special Edition]] card [[Brangus Glee]] is an anagram of Snuggle Bear.<ref name="geo">[https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], oocities.org (GeoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 200. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref> The card's lore reads:
<blockquote>Elder of a dextrous race of renowned travelers. Gambler. Frequents casinos, bars and spaceports. Originally from distant planet Dor Nameth</blockquote>
